reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Embla Carousel (https://www.embla-carousel.com/).
Technology stack: javascript, typescript, react, vue.
Component specification: Predefined Examples 给出 Default 现场轮播作为可复制标本。

Visual details from source observation: 首页写 lightweight carousel library with fluid motion。Get Started 按 Module、React、Vue、Svelte、Solid、CDN 分入口。Predefined Examples 给出 Default 现场轮播与 CodeSandbox。文档顶栏提示当前为 v9.0.0-rc03。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
